title: 18 January Goma protest against the East African Community regional force
reason: Wrong country: Goma is in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Congo-Kinshasa), outside the assigned Republic of the Congo/Congo-Brazzaville unit.
notes: Search results identify Goma and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. AP is under the inherited publisher hold; VOA’s result attributes observation to AFP; TV5MONDE’s underlying reporting relationship was not verified. This false-positive lead is excluded on country scope alone.

title: University Marien-Ngouabi intersyndical declaration about university budget
reason: The opened newspaper excerpt documents publication of a union declaration but does not establish a qualifying demonstration, strike, or public meeting of at least 50 people.
notes: The issue says the declaration was made public in Brazzaville on 24 January. That is a publication date, not a verified physical event date. No attendance, event format, or end is reported in the partial read. Retained as an unresolved lead in gap G002; it is not an event or an absence finding.

title: Alleged customs-office barricade threat
reason: The partial newspaper excerpt describes circulating allegations of a planned barricade that the customs and worker unions denied; no executed gathering is documented.
notes: The paper dates the unions’ denial to 23 January, but does not date any alleged action or report an assembled crowd. No protest is coded.
